player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i tetahi {num_rounds}-raunga o IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
I ia raunga, whakapapa he tau i waenganui i {min_guess} me {max_guess}.
I muri i nga whakapapa e rua, ko te whakatinga ko (2/3)x(te paunga o nga whakapapa e rua),
ko te kaitakaro e tata ana tana whakapapa ki te whakatinga ka wini taua raunga.
Whakautu ki to whakapapa i te ahua '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore i te tika; tēnā tuku mai tō whakaaro hei [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Me whakaaro koe kei waenganui i {min_guess} me te {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Kaitakaro 0 i whakapapa {guess0}; Kaitakaro 1 i whakapapa {guess1}. Koina te Whakatinga ko: {target}.
message.round_win: Ka wikitoria te kaitākaro {winner} i te rauna!

outcome.p0_wins: I toa ake te kaitākaro 0 i ētahi atu rauna.
outcome.p1_wins: I toa ake te kaitākaro 1 i ngā rauna.
